Title: Retrieve paginated list of orders for a shop with default sorting by newest first
Section: Order Management - Paginated Order List for Shop
Preconditions: Shop with ID 1 has at least 3 orders recorded, with the newest order having the highest ID
Steps: 1. Send a GET request to /api/orders/shop/1 with default pagination parameters (page=0, limit=10).
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Orders retrieved successfully", "data": {"content": [<list of orders sorted by ID in descending order>], "totalElements": >=3, "totalPages": >=1}}

Title: Retrieve orders by shop with minimum allowed page value
Preconditions: User has at least one order recorded for a shop
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/orders/shop/{shopId} with query parameters page=0 and limit=10.

Test Data: {"shopId": 1, "page": 0, "limit": 10}
Expected Result: The API responds with a 200 OK status code, a status of 'success', and the response body contains 'data' with a list of orders for the shop.
